pieces.doc: Disclosed content panel for a `ForDisclosure`. The directive does not manage DOM presence — wrap with `@if (open())` so the panel mounts and unmounts with the disclosure state, and use `animate.enter` / `animate.leave` for transitions if desired. If the consumer prefers to keep the panel mounted (for CSS-only transitions or to preserve internal state), the directive reflects `aria-hidden="true"` and `inert` while closed so the panel is removed from the accessibility tree and focus order automatically.
Trigger button for a `ForDisclosure`. Apply on a `<button type="button">` so Enter/Space toggling come from native button behavior.
Root of the Disclosure primitive. Holds the open/disabled state and the IDs that wire the trigger to its content.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.doc: When true, click on the trigger is ignored and `data-disabled` is reflected.

models.name: open
models.doc: Two-way bindable open state. Use `[(open)]` for both read & write, or `(openChange)` alone to observe transitions when the directive itself toggles state (trigger click). The `model()` change emitter does NOT fire for consumer-driven writes via `[(open)]`, so subscribing to `(openChange)` is safe and only sees internal transitions.
